name: Listings import speed
ownerWords: (10-20, msg mvfzxhgy) the listings import in here is painfully slow. i need at least 20x more rows a minute, get it there and keep the rows/min on the board
goal: The listings import in ~/work/listings-import-r2-6a3fe60 loads at least 20 times the rows a minute of the old import (commit fb843e4, 91,344 rows/min on 10-20). Each run times the old import and the current one back to back on the same box, so the box's load does not move the verdict, and shows the current import's rows a minute at the baseline's load.

metrics.label: Import rows a minute at the 91,344 baseline's load (current over old fb843e4, timed back to back)

onMiss: Read the timing item: the two current runs, the old run and the load. When a current run printed no summary or failed, fix the precheck or the import first. When the ratio is under 20x, find what made the current import slower than its 5.0M rows/min of 10-20 (commit 5771050) by diffing importer/run.py and config/limits.json since then, and start a fix job with rlm.create_session that lands the change in the listings import repo, then set the fix step's duty, job and sessionId. Never time runs against the repo's own out/listings.db, and send nothing outside.
